crossRefs.note: “Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been carried from their birth…
Give ear, and hear my voice! Listen, and hear my speech!
“Assemble yourselves and come. Draw near together, you who have escaped from the nations. Those have no knowledge who…
Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
“How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools…
Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.
Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?
Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing;’ and don’t know that you are the…
I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe…
Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow bronze;
Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.
But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.
Yes, they made their hearts as hard as flint, lest they might hear the law, and the words which Yahweh of Armies had…
“Your words have been stout against me,” says Yahweh. “Yet you say, ‘What have we spoken against you?’
“You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you…
They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.
Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.
Yahweh says, “What unrighteousness have your fathers found in me, that they have gone far from me, and have walked…
But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

translations.web: Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted, who are far from righteousness!
translations.bsb: Listen to Me, you stubborn people, far removed from righteousness:
translations.kjv: Hearken unto me, ye stouthearted, that are far from righteousness:
translations.asv: Hearken unto me, ye stout-hearted, that are far from righteousness:
